verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's API documentation lists a campaign reporting endpoint ("Get campaign report: clicked"), and the API offers paginated collections and documented rate limits, so pulling campaign metrics into a warehouse is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows automation/flow performance metrics being available via the API, and the breadth of campaign report data is only implied by a single endpoint link. Missing for 10: automation/flow performance metrics via API, documentation of the full set of campaign report metrics (opens, bounces, unsubscribes, aggregates), and independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse/dashboard extraction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards

citations.quote: When you request a collection of entities, such as contacts belonging to a list, the data will be paginated rather than returned all at once.
This system enables a steady request rate of up to 10 per second or a burst of up to 100 requests in a single instance if needed.
